conditions: Selection only, locked Playwright 1.64.1, Windows x64, one worker and zero retries. Full captures remain in ignored tmp/issue-259. Existing approved 23 matrix reductions remain unchanged.
retainedObligations: Existing persistence, corruption, exact backup/raw export, stale reset/removal, legal terminal, replay, floor, item and actual history/BFCache cases keep their titles/IDs and now use root game entries.

The new main radial preference reload case retains its ID and preference assertions, expects a fresh transient battle and removes its direct-route saved Continue assumption. Added radial boundary cases prove all three testing game owners preserve primary/backup/handoff bytes through real actions, restart, reload and actual Back, and a menu-owned radial battle preserves exact accepted state across Continue.

The unchanged-ID custom later-ability fixture cases now reset after asserting accepted replay commands; fictional zz_* abilities have no production save contract. Production learned-ability persistence remains in menu-owned extended journeys.
The unchanged-ID rejected-capacity/active-item fixture reload reconstructs its explicit fresh active boundary; saved active RNG/ownership is covered by menu item and run/dungeon reload cases.

New isolation cases cover all seven direct/diagnostic families, storage conditions, forged intents, exact primary/backup/handoff sentinels, actions, restart, synthetic visibility/pagehide cleanup and fresh reload. Existing actual BFCache cases remain on persistent root play.
New transient legal dungeon play clears three encounters with normal UI input, descends and backtracks. The additional menu Mage corpus retains exact XP/caster-level boundaries for 0/60/180/600 XP.
